# Academic Progress

- 2023: Professorship, Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research, Rostock — fourth place

## Awards

- 2017: **Best Paper Award** at the joint 15th DeLFI (GI) and 25th GMW conference, TU Chemnitz, for my paper on digital media used for inquiry-based learning
- Nominated for best paper at DeLFI for my paper on starting a methodology for technology based learning
- 2014/15: **Distinction for the best graduates of the year**, University of Potsdam

## Teaching Appointments

- since 2026: Guest lecturer at **RWTH Aachen University** — pilot courses of the national RSE master curriculum (*teachingRSE*): *Research Methods and Methodology for Research Software Engineers* and *RSE Management and Communication*
- from 2026/27: Guest lecturer at the **University of Potsdam** — *Responsible RSE* and *Software Evaluation*, standing in for Prof. Anna-Lena Lamprecht during her research sabbatical
